# Working Holiday Tax - expanded content index (EN / DE / JA / FR / IT / ES)

> A complete, current map of every guide on https://workingholidaytax.com.au, with the description for each. Generated from the live guide data, so it cannot list an article that no longer exists.

## About this file

Generated 2026-11-06 by scripts/generate-llms.mjs. Do not hand edit.

This file is an index, not a dump of article bodies. It lists 144 English guides, 144 German translations and 144 Japanese translations, with the canonical URL, category, publication date and description for each. Fetch the canonical URL for the full text. A localised guide is listed only where a translated body exists; partially translated entries are noindexed and are deliberately omitted. French, Italian and Spanish sections list their language pages and, per guide, the canonical URL, category, publication date and the native title and summary of that language's page.

Authoritative current figures, with effective dates and sources, are in https://workingholidaytax.com.au/llms.txt. Prefer that file for any rate or threshold.

## How a return is handled

Prepared by our team, reviewed and signed off by a registered tax agent before it is lodged with the ATO.

## Guarantee

If your refund is less than our fee, we refund the difference once the ATO has issued your Notice of Assessment. If there is no refund, or you owe tax, the full fee applies.

# French / Français (fr) - 144 native guides

Nous nous occupons de votre TFN, de votre déclaration d’impôts, du retrait de votre super et de votre ABN si vous êtes en visa vacances-travail en Australie. Vérifié et validé par un agent fiscal enregistré avant d’être déposé auprès de l’ATO.

Notre garantie : si votre remboursement d’impôt est inférieur à nos honoraires, nous vous remboursons la différence, après réception du Notice of Assessment. S’il n’y a aucun remboursement, ou si vous avez de l’impôt à payer, la totalité des honoraires s’applique.

# Italian / Italiano (it) - 144 native guides

Ci occupiamo di TFN, dichiarazione dei redditi, rimborso della super e ABN per chi è in Australia con un visto working holiday. Rivista e approvata da un agente fiscale registrato prima di essere presentata all’ATO.

La nostra garanzia: se il tuo rimborso fiscale è inferiore alla nostra tariffa, ti rimborsiamo la differenza dopo il Notice of Assessment. Se non c’è rimborso o devi pagare imposte, si applica l’intera tariffa.

# Spanish / Español (es) - 144 native guides
# ============================================================

Nos encargamos del TFN, la declaración de impuestos, el retiro de la super y el ABN si estás en Australia con una visa working holiday. Revisado y aprobado por un agente fiscal registrado antes de presentarse ante la ATO.

Nuestra garantía: si tu devolución es menor que la tarifa, te devolvemos la diferencia después del Notice of Assessment. Si no hay devolución o debes dinero a la ATO, se aplica la tarifa completa.
